Class 10 · Quadratic Equations

Q1. Find the roots of 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0 by factorisation. [3 marks]

  1. 2x² − 6x − x + 3 = 0
  2. 2x(x − 3) − 1(x − 3) = 0
  3. (2x − 1)(x − 3) = 0
  4. x = −1/2 or x = 3
